documents.title: Fictional Q2 ad efficiency memo
documents.content: Fictional company Qinglan Beauty set the ad CPA target at 48 yuan. The current blended ROI is 2.8, above the industry benchmark of 2.1. The memo recommends cutting spend only after human review.

documents.title: Fictional July GMV channel review
documents.content: Fictional company Qinglan Beauty reported July GMV of 8.6 million yuan, up 18 percent month over month. Douyin livestream contributed 52 percent of the growth, while store search contributed 21 percent.

documents.title: Fictional short video content plan
documents.content: The short video plan says the first three seconds should show the before-and-after skin texture comparison. It also says creator clips should avoid medical claims and use product routine demonstrations.

documents.title: Fictional customer service SLA
documents.content: Customer service SLA requires first response within 60 seconds during campaign hours. Refund questions should be escalated to a human reviewer before any compensation promise is made.
